Yes, the limit is now 20 everywhere I could find. The cart limit was defined in two places, and I changed both:

- `src/limits.ts:1`: `MAX_ITEMS` is now 20.
- `src/legacy/limits.ts:1`: `LEGACY_MAX_ITEMS` is now 20. This was a separate, duplicate constant. Nothing in `src` imports it, and only the test uses it.
- `test/unit/limits.test.ts`: both boundary tests now check `canAdd(20)` and `legacyCanAdd(20)`.

The full suite passes (7 of 7) after the edits. A search of the repo for other hard-coded limits turned up none. The README has no mention of the limit either.

`src/cart.ts` doesn't use `canAdd`, so nothing in the code enforces the limit yet. That was already the case before my change.
